# Apostrophe Communications

> Apostrophe Communications is an award-winning PR and integrated communications agency based in New Delhi, India, with partner offices in Mumbai, Bangalore, Hyderabad, Chennai. Founded in 2017 by Kritika Lalchandani, it has worked with 250+ premium Indian and global brands across luxury, fashion, lifestyle, beauty, interiors and hospitality, with campaigns in 18+ cities. Its awards include Rising PR Consultancy of the Year (BW Excel Awards 2025), Gold at AFAQs Communicon 2025 and Silver at ET Kaleido 2024.

Website: https://apostrophecommunications.com/
Contact: connect@apostrophecommunications.com
Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/apostrophe.communications/
LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/company/apostrophe-communications/
Studio: 67, Lower Ground Floor, Hemkunt Colony, Greater Kailash 1, New Delhi 110048

## Case studies

### BVLGARI × Johnson Watch Co.: Octo Finissimo Saga showcase, New Delhi
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=bvlgari-jwc
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Experiences & Activations, Media & Storytelling.

Background: Bvlgari, in partnership with Johnson Watch Co., brought its world-record Octo Finissimo Saga Collection and High Jewellery Watches to New Delhi for an exclusive showcase. The occasion called for an experience that matched the rarity and prestige of the collection, while bringing together the right community of luxury consumers and collectors.

Objective: To curate a high-value guest experience that placed the collection in front of key customers, collectors and buyers, while ensuring every element of the event reflected the exclusivity and sophistication associated with Bvlgari.

Solution: Apostrophe led the guest strategy and event experience, identifying and inviting a carefully curated audience of high-value customers and prospective buyers. We managed guest outreach and RSVPs while working closely with Johnson Watch Co. to ensure a seamless flow throughout the event.
From the guest journey to on-ground coordination, our role was focused on creating an environment where the collection could take centre stage, allowing the craftsmanship, innovation and world-record design of the Octo Finissimo Saga to speak for itself.

Impact: The showcase brought together a curated audience of luxury consumers and buyers for an exclusive encounter with Bvlgari's exceptional timepieces and High Jewellery Watches, strengthening the brand's engagement with the Delhi luxury community and reinforcing Johnson Watch Co.'s positioning as a destination for exceptional horology.

### Rado: 40 years of ceramic watchmaking
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=rado
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Media & Storytelling, Digital Influence.
Result: 40 Years of ceramic, amplified

Background: RADO's 40-year legacy of ceramic watchmaking marked a significant milestone for the brand, amplified by the announcement of Smriti Mandhana as its Friend of the Brand. The moment brought together RADO's heritage in high-performance materials with one of India's most recognisable sporting voices.

Objective: To build strong, high-quality visibility around the partnership and the 40-year ceramic watchmaking milestone, while positioning the announcement at the intersection of luxury, watchmaking, sport and contemporary culture.

Solution: Apostrophe delivered an integrated PR and digital amplification campaign spanning luxury, lifestyle, sports and business media.
We led end-to-end media relations, editorial outreach, interview opportunities, feature stories and press communication, developing and distributing the press narrative alongside official imagery and video assets. The campaign was structured to ensure consistency across every touchpoint while giving different media categories a relevant entry point into the story.
The digital layer extended the announcement beyond traditional media through strategic content seeding across paparazzi pages, sports platforms and relevant community channels, creating additional visibility around the partnership and driving real-time conversations.
A live coverage dossier and reporting dashboard ran alongside the campaign, giving the RADO team a clear view of media traction, live conversations and upcoming opportunities throughout the campaign.

Impact: The campaign created multi-platform visibility for RADO's 40-year ceramic watchmaking legacy and its association with Smriti Mandhana, extending the announcement across luxury, lifestyle, sports and business audiences.
By combining earned media with targeted digital amplification, Apostrophe helped turn a brand announcement into a broader cultural conversation around RADO's heritage, innovation and contemporary relevance.

### TASVA by Tarun Tahiliani: Baraat, Hyderabad & Lakmé Fashion Week
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=tasva
Sector: Fashion & Lifestyle. Work: Celebrity Relations, Experiences & Activations.
Result: ₹63.5Cr EMV, Baraat by TASVA
Result: ₹39.1Cr EMV, Hyderabad launch

Background: Apostrophe has partnered with TASVA across multiple high-visibility fashion and retail moments, supporting the brand's evolution through standalone fashion showcases, celebrity-led events, store launches and Lakmé Fashion Week appearances.
The mandate has consistently focused on bringing together fashion, celebrity, media, influencers and culturally relevant social communities to create visibility around TASVA's contemporary interpretation of Indian occasionwear.

Objective: To establish TASVA as a prominent contemporary Indian occasionwear brand, generate national and regional visibility around key brand moments, and use high-profile personalities, fashion platforms and social communities to create sustained conversation and cultural relevance.

Solution: Apostrophe has led communications and on-ground amplification across multiple TASVA initiatives, including Baraat by TASVA, the Hyderabad store launch and TASVA's Lakmé Fashion Week debut.
Baraat by TASVA: TASVA's First-Ever Standalone Show
Apostrophe supported TASVA's first-ever standalone show, Baraat by TASVA, creating a fashion-first moment around the brand's wedding and festive proposition.
The mandate included exclusive national and regional media interactions with Ranbir Kapoor and Tarun Tahiliani, facilitating interviews with both personalities, closing personalities to walk the runway, and onboarding and dressing influencers for the event.
Apostrophe also activated community pages, wedding pages, fan pages and paparazzi platforms, alongside model and influencer collaborations, to extend the show's visibility beyond the physical event. The guest and media strategy secured CAT-A coverage across fashion, lifestyle and entertainment media, supported by on-ground event coordination.
Key personalities and collaborators associated with the event included Ranbir Kapoor, Tarun Tahiliani, Manav Chhabra, Unnati Malharkar, Apoorva aka The Rebel Kid, Anubhav Singh Bassi and Suvir Saran.
The event generated an EMV of ₹63.5 Cr, derived from the compilation of paid and earned media.
TASVA Hyderabad Store Launch
For TASVA's Himayath Nagar store launch in Hyderabad, Apostrophe created a regional fashion moment around a celebrity-led “Baraat”, featuring Naga Chaitanya, alongside Tarun Tahiliani and brand head Ashish Mukul.
Apostrophe managed guest-listing, exclusive national and regional media interactions, influencer dressing, community and wedding-page activations, paparazzi outreach, alcohol sponsorship and on-ground event coordination.
The launch generated significant buzz across social and community platforms, with extensive paparazzi and media coverage positioning the store opening as a notable fashion event within Hyderabad's social circuit.
The event generated an EMV of ₹39.1 Cr, derived from paid and earned media.
TASVA × Lakmé Fashion Week 2023
Apostrophe supported TASVA's debut at Lakmé Fashion Week 2023, managing the celebrity and influencer ecosystem around the show.
The agency onboarded celebrity and influencer faces to participate in the walk, managed end-to-end coordination, and negotiated and onboarded Vijay Varma as the showstopper.
Apostrophe also facilitated media interviews with Tarun Tahiliani and Vijay Varma, managed media and influencer attendance and seating, coordinated event requirements, and led media coverage and tracking. Visual content creation further extended the show's impact beyond the runway.

Impact: Across these initiatives, Apostrophe helped TASVA turn key brand moments into high-visibility cultural and fashion occasions, combining celebrity influence with editorial media, influencer advocacy and targeted social amplification.
The work generated substantial earned and paid media visibility, including ₹63.5 Cr EMV for Baraat by TASVA and ₹39.1 Cr EMV for the Hyderabad store launch, while TASVA's Fashion Week debut established the brand within the national fashion calendar with Vijay Varma as showstopper.
The continued engagement across multiple TASVA initiatives reflects Apostrophe's ability to build long-term brand momentum rather than isolated event visibility, connecting fashion, celebrity, media and community ecosystems around the brand.

### Tarun Tahiliani: A long-term luxury narrative
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=tarun-tahiliani
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Celebrity Relations, Fashion & Design Culture.
Result: 25 Celebrity placements in six months

Background: Apostrophe has been a long-term communications partner for Tarun Tahiliani, shaping the designer's luxury narrative across editorial, celebrity, campaign and Fashion Week touchpoints. The partnership has focused on building sustained visibility for the designer while strengthening his relevance across India's fashion and luxury ecosystem.

Objective: To consistently position Tarun Tahiliani at the intersection of Indian luxury, contemporary couture and cultural relevance, while building strong editorial relationships, increasing celebrity visibility and creating sustained momentum around key collections and Fashion Week moments.

Solution: Apostrophe has led an integrated communications mandate spanning media relations, celebrity sourcing, editorial dressing, brand positioning, Fashion Week PR and campaign coverage.
A strategic celebrity dressing programme delivered 20–25 celebrity placements within six months, creating repeated visibility for Tarun Tahiliani across high-profile fashion and entertainment audiences. Celebrity sourcing included Bhumi Pednekar, Sobhita Dhulipala, Kiara Advani, Janhvi Kapoor, Karisma Kapoor and Sara Ali Khan, among others.
The agency also drove CAT-A influencer collaborations, using relevant fashion voices to extend the designer's collections and brand narrative beyond traditional editorial media.
For FDCI x Lakmé Fashion Week, Apostrophe managed end-to-end press and campaign communications, creating visibility around the designer's participation and ensuring coordinated coverage across fashion, lifestyle and culture media.
A structured editorial outreach programme was also implemented to build stronger and more consistent relationships with leading fashion publications, including Vogue India, ELLE India, Mint Lounge and Brides Today, alongside other key fashion and luxury titles.

Impact: The long-term partnership has strengthened Tarun Tahiliani's visibility across fashion, luxury, celebrity and editorial ecosystems, with sustained celebrity dressing, influencer engagement and Fashion Week coverage contributing to greater desirability and cultural relevance.
The combination of 20–25 celebrity dressing wins in six months, CAT-A influencer associations and strategic Fashion Week PR has helped maintain a consistent luxury narrative around the designer while deepening relationships with India's leading fashion media.

### Lladró: India Uncovered at India Design
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=lladro
Sector: Interiors & Living. Work: Fashion & Design Culture, Strategic Collaborations.

Background: Apostrophe partnered with Lladró around its participation at India Design, creating a multi-layered communications programme to introduce the brand's luxury design philosophy, artistic heritage and craftsmanship to India's influential design, architecture and lifestyle audiences.

Objective: To maximise Lladró's visibility around India Design, strengthen its credibility within the Indian design ecosystem, and demonstrate the versatility of its pieces through meaningful engagement with architects, interior designers, influencers and design-focused audiences.

Solution: Apostrophe built an integrated programme around India Design and AD associations, guest-listing, influencer engagement, architect collaborations and curated content creation, anchored by the Lladró India Uncovered campaign.
To generate pre-event anticipation, Apostrophe collaborated with influential design and lifestyle voices including Navneet Randhawa, Bahaar Rohatgi and Ridhi Khosla Jalan, using the India Uncovered narrative to create social media buzz ahead of the event.
The agency also facilitated collaborations with leading architects including Ajay Arya, Huzefa Rangwala, Jasem Pirani of MuseLAB and Karan Desai, strengthening Lladró's relationships within India's professional design community and reinforcing its credibility within the architecture and interiors ecosystem.
Three interior designers were further engaged to place Lladró products within homes across different aesthetics, demographics and locations, demonstrating the versatility of the pieces and how they could integrate into varied interior environments.
Apostrophe also managed guest-listing for the brand's India Design presence and facilitated influencer content generation at the booth, extending the physical showcase into digital conversations.

Impact: The programme created visibility for Lladró across design, architecture, interiors, influencer and lifestyle communities, while positioning the brand within the larger conversation around contemporary Indian design.
Through a combination of premium event associations, influential design voices, architect partnerships and real-world product placements, Apostrophe helped communicate Lladró's timeless craftsmanship, artistic legacy and versatility to a broader and highly relevant audience.

### Bath & Body Works: Disney Collection launch & always-on creator campaigns
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=bath-body-works
Sector: Fashion & Lifestyle. Work: Influencer Relations, Experiences & Activations, Media & Storytelling, Retail & Store Launches.
Result: 9+ Stores in the Disney Collection launch
Result: 4.7M Combined following, Disney creator campaign
Result: 800K+ Reel views, Disney creator campaign

Background: Bath & Body Works is a retainer partner. Apostrophe owns the brand's influencer strategy in India end to end, alongside media relations, store launch events and campaign strategy, across collection drops from Touch of Gold and Closer to the Bath & Body Works × Disney Princess Collection.

Objective: To make influencer marketing a consistent, always-on growth lever for Bath & Body Works across India: building anticipation ahead of every major collection drop, amplifying launch events in real time and driving its key sale periods.
For the Disney Princess Collection, the brief was a launch that felt playful yet premium, brought the right creators and editors into the stores, and turned launch-day buzz into sales.

Solution: Apostrophe builds nationwide creator campaigns around every major collection drop, including Touch of Gold, Closer and the ongoing Disney collection, driving pre-launch anticipation and real-time event amplification. The influencer engine spans multiple cities and runs alongside dedicated launch events.
Creator activations were also extended to drive the Semi-Annual Sale and the Summer End of Season Sale.
Bath & Body Works × Disney Collection
Apostrophe led the India launch of the Disney Princess Collection across 9+ stores, including Delhi, Mumbai, Ahmedabad and Hyderabad. Each launch was built as a playful but premium in-store experience, with Disney-themed décor, product discovery zones and interactive moments made to be shared.
The launch brought together:
- Launch events at DLF Promenade, DLF Mall of India and Ambience Mall Gurgaon, each with a guestlister bringing in a curated circle of creators and tastemakers
- 160+ guests sharing the Delhi NCR launches on their stories, with editors from Cosmopolitan, HELLO! and India Today in attendance
- City community pages including So Delhi, Noida Beyond and What's Up Gurgaon
- A creator campaign with 9 influencers, including Smriti Khanna, Deeksha Mishra, Niki Mehra and Natasha Luthra, through store visits in Delhi, Mumbai, Hyderabad and Pune and home shoots
- Media outreach that placed the collection in HELLO! India, ELLE India, Luxurious by MM and Local Samosa
Collection Launch Event
Apostrophe's role included:
- End-to-end launch execution, with two guestlisters onboarded and on-ground management
- Experiential and décor: décor and F&B curation, a charm station experience and mall pop-up execution
- Media and PR: aligned Global VP interactions, press release dissemination, media invites and gifting, and post-event coverage
- Digital amplification: influencer campaign management, digital storytelling and visibility strategy

Impact: The Disney Collection sold from day one. On launch day it made up 21% of sales at DLF Promenade, 19.8% at DLF Mall of India and 16% at Ambience Mall Gurgaon.
The creator campaign reached a combined following of 4.7M, and its reels drew more than 800K views, with Deeksha Mishra's reel alone crossing 3 lakh. Features in HELLO! India, ELLE India, Luxurious by MM and Local Samosa added ₹1.5M in PR value within three weeks of launch.
For the End of Season Sale, Apostrophe delivered massive-scale campaigns within short timelines and limited budgets, proving the efficiency and agility of the influencer engine.
Influencer marketing is now a consistent, always-on growth lever for Bath & Body Works across India.

### Chopard × Johnson Watch Co.: L.U.C collection launch
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=chopard-jwc
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Experiences & Activations, Strategic Collaborations.

Background: Chopard, in association with Johnson Watch Co., launched its L.U.C collection in New Delhi, bringing its exceptional watchmaking craftsmanship to an audience of discerning collectors, luxury consumers and horology enthusiasts. The launch required an experience that could communicate the sophistication of the collection while creating a genuinely engaging setting for the watch community.

Objective: To design and execute an immersive, luxury-led launch experience that brought together the right mix of media, influencers, collectors and watch enthusiasts, while creating a distinctive narrative around the craftsmanship and character of the L.U.C collection.

Solution: Apostrophe served as PR and Event Partner, managing the launch from concept through execution.
We led venue identification, event setup, logistics, décor, menu curation and guest invitations, bringing together a carefully selected audience of media, influencers, luxury consumers and watch enthusiasts. We also facilitated the collaboration with the J9 Watch Collectors community, creating a more authentic connection with the horology ecosystem.
To give the collection a more experiential narrative, we brought watch enthusiast and sommelier Magandeep Singh into the experience for a curated whiskey-pairing session. Each L.U.C timepiece was paired with a complementary malt, using the language of taste, craftsmanship and detail to bring the character of the watches to life.

Impact: The launch transformed a traditional collection showcase into a multi-sensory experience rooted in horology, craftsmanship and luxury culture.
The combination of a highly curated guest list, collector-community engagement and the whiskey-pairing experience created a more meaningful setting for the L.U.C collection, while strengthening Chopard and Johnson Watch Co.'s engagement with Delhi's luxury and watch enthusiast community.

### Omega × Ethos Watch Co.: An exclusive SIS activation, Ludhiana
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=omega-ethos
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Experiences & Activations, Media & Storytelling.

Background: Omega, in association with Ethos Watch Co., brought its luxury watchmaking experience to Ludhiana through an exclusive SIS-led activation. The occasion called for a carefully curated experience that could engage the city's luxury consumers, watch enthusiasts and relevant media and influencer community.

Objective: To create and execute a seamless, premium launch experience that brought Omega closer to Ludhiana's luxury audience, while ensuring the right mix of media, influencers, watch enthusiasts and high-value guests.

Solution: Apostrophe served as PR & Event Partner, managing the event across guest curation, logistics and on-ground execution.
We handled venue identification, event setup, décor, menu selection and cost coordination, while curating and inviting relevant media, influencers and watch enthusiasts. A dedicated guest-lister was also brought on board to strengthen the quality and relevance of the audience.
From the initial planning through on-ground execution, Apostrophe managed the multiple moving parts of the experience to ensure a smooth, considered and brand-aligned event journey.

Impact: The activation created a focused platform for Omega and Ethos Watch Co. to engage Ludhiana's luxury and horology community, bringing together relevant audiences in an experience designed around the stature of the brand.
The seamless integration of PR, guest curation and event execution enabled Omega to extend its presence beyond the retail environment and create a more personal connection with its local luxury consumer base.

### Mrunalini Rao: Hastakala: ten years of craft
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=mrunalini-rao
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Media & Storytelling, Celebrity Relations.
Result: 13M+ Reach
Result: ₹9.6M+ PR value

Background: Mrunalini Rao has built a distinctive space in contemporary Indian luxury, rooted in craft, couture and modern design. Apostrophe has been the communications partner behind the brand's growing national visibility, supporting key milestones from the Ensemble store launch and 10th anniversary celebrations to ongoing media and celebrity initiatives.

Objective: To establish Mrunalini Rao as a distinctive voice in contemporary Indian luxury and craft, while building sustained visibility across fashion, lifestyle and luxury media and strengthening the brand's presence among influential cultural and celebrity circles.

Solution: Apostrophe built an integrated communications programme spanning media relations, celebrity dressing, brand positioning, store launch PR and anniversary events.
We developed sustained relationships with leading fashion, lifestyle and luxury publications including Vogue India, Harper's Bazaar India, ELLE, Bazaar, Lifestyle Asia and Luxebook, creating consistent editorial opportunities around the brand, its collections and its larger design philosophy.
For the 'Hastakala' 10th anniversary showcase at Ensemble, Mumbai, Apostrophe led targeted editorial outreach to build anticipation and secure post-event coverage. Alongside media, our celebrity dressing programme connected the brand with relevant Bollywood and arts personalities, extending its visibility beyond traditional fashion audiences.
The approach was designed to make Mrunalini Rao the story, not simply the collection, building recognition around her design voice, craftsmanship and place within India's evolving luxury landscape.

Impact: The communications programme delivered 13M+ reach and ₹9.6M+ in PR value, with extensive coverage around the brand's 10th anniversary showcase across leading fashion and luxury publications.
More importantly, the sustained media and celebrity strategy helped strengthen Mrunalini Rao's editorial presence, luxury positioning and recognition as a contemporary Indian craft voice, creating visibility that extended beyond individual launches and into the broader fashion conversation.

### Abraham & Thakore: Flagships, Fashion Week & Abraham & Thakore Home
https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=abraham-thakore
Sector: Luxury Retail. Work: Media & Storytelling, Fashion & Design Culture.
Result: 19.2M+ Reach
Result: ₹14.6M+ PR value
Result: 20+ Pieces of Home coverage

Background: The Label
Abraham & Thakore occupies a distinctive space in Indian fashion, bringing together traditional Indian craft, contemporary design and a strong point of view on modern luxury. Apostrophe has supported the brand across key retail milestones, collection launches, founder profiling and Fashion Week communications.
Abraham & Thakore Home
Apostrophe partnered with Abraham & Thakore Home to establish the home offering as a natural extension of the designers' established fashion identity, bringing their distinctive design language into the luxury interiors and lifestyle space.

Objective: The Label
To strengthen Abraham & Thakore’s visibility and reinforce its position as one of India’s leading contemporary designer labels, while creating high-impact moments around its flagship launches and translating the brand’s design legacy into broader fashion and cultural conversations.
Abraham & Thakore Home
To build a strong luxury positioning for Abraham & Thakore Home, leverage the equity of the existing fashion brand, and introduce the new offering to influential architecture, interiors, lifestyle and luxury audiences through credible editorial storytelling.

Solution: The Label
Apostrophe developed an integrated communications programme spanning media relations, influencer engagement, founder profiling, retail launches and Fashion Week amplification.
For the Hyderabad flagship launch, we supported a high-profile multi-designer showcase alongside Rahul Mishra and Satya Paul, bringing together celebrities, influencers, HNIs and key members of Hyderabad’s social circuit. A curated presentation of archival Abraham & Thakore pieces added a strong storytelling layer to the event, connecting the new retail presence with the brand’s design legacy.
For the Defence Colony flagship, Apostrophe built a curated launch experience around the brand’s fashion, home and lifestyle offering, bringing together media, influencers, HNIs and industry leaders. Strategic outreach before and around the launch helped extend the event beyond the physical experience and into editorial and digital conversations.
Alongside launches, we maintained a consistent media programme around collection launches, founder stories and the brand’s participation at FDCI x Lakmé Fashion Week, securing visibility across Elle India, Vogue India, Hello! India and The Voice of Fashion.
Abraham & Thakore Home
Apostrophe developed a focused traditional PR programme centred on editorial outreach, designer interactions and strategic media relationship building.
The campaign prioritised leading magazines, newspapers and digital platforms relevant to luxury, design and lifestyle, while creating opportunities for the designers to speak directly to media about the brand's evolution into home.
Media outreach targeted publications and platforms including Architectural Digest, India Today Home, ELLE Decor, The Telegraph, Times Now, Luxury Facts, Indulge (TNIE), India Today Lifestyle, GQ India, The Week and GoodHomes India.
Beyond coverage generation, Apostrophe facilitated 20+ media opportunities across print, online and electronic platforms, along with relationship-building meetings with top media houses. The programme was designed not simply to secure individual stories, but to establish long-term relationships with key publications and create a credible editorial foundation for the category.

Impact: The Label
The sustained communications programme delivered 19.2M+ reach and ₹14.6M+ in PR value.
Beyond individual launches, the work strengthened Abraham & Thakore’s visibility across fashion, luxury and design media, reinforcing its position as a leading voice in contemporary Indian design and creating sustained industry relevance across retail, collections and Fashion Week.
Abraham & Thakore Home
The campaign successfully introduced Abraham & Thakore Home to the luxury design and interiors ecosystem, generating 20+ pieces of coverage across print, digital and electronic media.
The sustained editorial approach helped establish the brand through factual, balanced and credible storytelling, while strengthening relationships with leading publications and creating a strong foundation for Abraham & Thakore's continued presence within the luxury home and design landscape.

https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=bally

Objective: To create an intimate, premium experience around the SS24 collection, strengthen Bally's engagement with its clientele, and generate meaningful brand visibility through a culturally relevant Father's Day moment.

https://apostrophecommunications.com/project.html?p=flow
Sector: Dining & Hospitality. Work: Experiences & Activations, Strategic Collaborations.
Result: 700+ Guests at launch
Result: 25+ Media queries in 11 weeks

Background: Apostrophe partnered with FLOW to build awareness around its launch and establish the venue as a relevant destination within Delhi's food, lifestyle and cultural ecosystem. The mandate extended beyond launch PR to include community building, media engagement, influencer programming and strategic collaborations that could sustain interest beyond the opening.

Objective: To create a high-impact launch for FLOW, establish strong visibility across Delhi's food, hospitality, lifestyle and design communities, and build an engaged network of influencers, media, social KOLs and community platforms that could drive sustained discovery and footfall.

Solution: Apostrophe conceptualised and coordinated the FLOW launch event, managing guest-listing and media outreach. The launch brought together 700+ influencers, social KOLs, friends and family, creating an immediate and high-energy introduction to the venue.
Key attendees included Tejeshwar Sandhoo, Param Sahib, Dhruv Oberoi, Suvir Saran, Gursakhi Lugani, Ikisvon, Ankita Rai Tiwari, Saasha Sarin, Shaurya Athley, Nirja Dutt, Hyesun Anh of the Korean Embassy, Magandeep Singh and Ankit Rai, alongside Amanda Bhandari and Jas Mehta.
Post-launch, Apostrophe maintained an active media and influencer engagement programme. The team coordinated 25+ media queries during the first 11 weeks, while aligning reviews and interactions with senior media and food critics including Marryam Reshi, Rocky & Mayur, Pawan Soni and Anoothi Vishal. Additional media critic interactions included Sameer Bawa.
The venue was positioned across relevant Category A print and digital publications, with coverage and outreach spanning Delhi Times / What's Hot, Architectural Digest, Financial Express, ET Hospitality, BW BusinessWorld, Architecture+Design, The Times of India and Travel + Leisure.
To sustain creator engagement, Apostrophe coordinated 15–20 influencer tables every month during the first quarter, creating an ongoing stream of organic discovery and social content rather than relying solely on launch-day visibility.
Community building formed another important pillar of the mandate. Apostrophe coordinated and organised two S.U.P.W. workshops, Cheers, in collaboration with The Ideas Lab and Shreya Soni, hosted The Leap Club's Six Thinking Hats – Delhi edition at FLOW, and coordinated the LBB × Pinterest “PINSPIRED: Pinterest Creators Connect” event.
The team also explored non-commercial digital collaborations with DforDelhi and developed community partnerships with Rupali Dean / The Explorers Club, The Leap Club and The Ideas Lab, including a sushi masterclass.

Impact: The launch established FLOW as a destination with immediate visibility across Delhi's hospitality, food, lifestyle, design and social communities, with 700+ attendees at the opening event and sustained influencer programming through the first quarter.
Within the first 11 weeks, Apostrophe coordinated 25+ media queries, secured visibility across leading print and digital publications, and created ongoing engagement through critic interactions, influencer tables and community-led experiences.
The approach helped FLOW move beyond a one-time launch moment to build an active ecosystem of media, creators, communities and cultural partners, giving the venue sustained relevance within Delhi's evolving hospitality landscape.
